name: Shimei
role: Benjamite of Saul's house who cursed David
whenBasis: In David's reign, ≈1010–970 BC, counted back from Solomon as Thiele does.
summary: Son of Gera, of Saul's clan. As David fled from Absalom, Shimei walked along the hillside at Bahurim cursing him and throwing stones: “Get out, get out, you worthless man of bloodshed!” David would not let Abishai kill him. On David's return Shimei met him at the Jordan and begged forgiveness, and David swore not to kill him; but he told Solomon to deal with him. Solomon confined him to Jerusalem, and when he left to fetch runaway slaves, had him executed.
body: He blames David for the blood of Saul's house. David says, “Leave him alone and let him curse me, for the LORD has told him so,” hoping the LORD will see his affliction.
Solomon's condition is simple: the day he crosses the Kidron he will die. Three years later two of his slaves run to Gath, he goes after them, and Benaiah strikes him down.
